verdict.rationale: Trello's own docs list a built-in AI feature to 'help write or edit content', so a user can hand writing and editing work to an in-product assistant. Nothing shows the assistant taking on broader tasks such as creating cards, organizing boards, or running multi-step work. The MCP server connects external AI tools rather than providing a built-in assistant, and the non-AI automation features are adjacent, so neither is credited. Missing for 10: evidence of agentic task delegation beyond writing/editing, documentation of the assistant's scope and actions on boards and cards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Use AI to help write or edit content
